nodes.description: Private owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor; used as the privileged actor in ensure, delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping(address=>uint) tracking token balances; mutated with unchecked += and -= in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances; decremented with unchecked -= in transferFrom.
Address whitelisted via setTradeAddress and compared inside ensure to bypass sale conditions.
Map<address=>bool> whitelist read in ensure that lets an address skip the condition() checks.
Public supply value minted in the constructor via an unchecked multiplication by 10**decimals.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance checks, ensure() whitelist/condition checks and balance updates with unchecked arithmetic.
Internal view gate comparing _from/_to against owner, UNI, the computed pair and tradeAddress/canSale before falling back to condition().
Owner-only function that executes a.delegatecall(b), allowing arbitrary delegatecall into an attacker-controlled address.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum from token amounts scaled by 10**decimals.
Owner-only batch distribution looping over _tos and crediting balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic and duplicate Transfer events.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
Caller-controlled address used for access checks, allowance spending and balance ownership.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executing arbitrary external code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value plus allowance decrement without SafeMath.
Unchecked total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total arithmetic in the batch loop.
Destination address parameter of transfer/transferFrom and member of the ensure whitelist comparison.
Amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom/batchSend used in the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
Source address parameter of transferFrom and ensure, compared against owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale.
Target address of the delegatecall inside delegate().
Calldata bytes forwarded to the delegatecall inside delegate().
Array of recipient addresses iterated by batchSend.
Local total = _value * _tos.length computed without overflow checking in batchSend.
Locally computed Uniswap pair address from pairFor(...) compared inside ensure.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards the caller msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
transferFrom() derives spending rights from msg.sender via allowance[_from][msg.sender].
delegate() guards the privileged delegatecall with require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner) before mass balance updates.
setTradeAddress() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
_to parameter flows into the internal transferFrom call made by transfer().
_value parameter is forwarded to transferFrom by transfer().
_to is credited in balanceOf[_to] += _value inside transferFrom.
_value is used in the allowance decrement and unchecked balance arithmetic of transferFrom.
_from selects the debited balance and the spendable allowance entry in transferFrom.
_from is compared against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale in ensure().
_to participates in the owner/whitelist comparison inside ensure().
_value is passed to condition(_from, _value) for sale bound checks.
Attacker-controlled address a is the delegatecall target executed by delegate().
Attacker-supplied calldata b is executed via delegatecall in the contract context.
_tos array drives the recipient loop of batchSend.
Local total feeds the unchecked subtraction from balanceOf[msg.sender] in batchSend.
balanceOf entries are debited/credited with unchecked -= and += in transferFrom.
batchSend reads and mutates balanceOf values without overflow protection.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read and decremented in transferFrom.
tradeAddress is compared against _from inside ensure() to bypass sale conditions.
canSale[_from] is read in ensure() to whitelist senders.
delegate() performs an arbitrary external delegatecall that can re-enter or rewrite contract storage.
transfer() returns the result of the internal transferFrom() call.
transferFrom() requires ensure(...) to succeed before mutating balances.
The batchSend loop executes the unchecked total/volume arithmetic on each iteration.
transferFrom() reaches the unchecked balance and allowance mutations.
